title: AuditEvent
description: One entry in the append-only, hash-chained audit trail. Each entry embeds the hash of its predecessor so any edit or deletion is detectable. A correction creates a new linked event — it never rewrites an old one.

at.description: Timestamp of the event (ISO 8601 or Pandas Timestamp string).

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the preceding entry. Genesis entry uses 64 zeros.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of this entry (excluding the hash field itself).

payload.description: Event-specific structured data. Contents vary by kind.
